cards.claim: The Revolutionary Left Movement was founded in 1971.
cards.quote: The MIR was founded in 1971 by a merger of a left-wing faction of Bolivia's Christian Democratic Party and the radical student wing of the Revolutionary Nationalist Movement (MNR).

cards.claim: The Revolutionary Left Movement was founded in 1962.
cards.quote: Revolutionary Left Movement (Peru) The Revolutionary Left Movement (in Spanish: "Movimiento de la Izquierda Revolucionaria") was a Marxist group founded in Peru in 1962 by Luis de la Puente Uceda and his group "APRA Rebelde", a splinter group from the APRA which had rallied the government in the 1950s and 1960s.
